name: usb-mini-b-port
description: A USB Mini-B socket with stepped side walls.
useCase: Identify a Mini-B connection on a camera, controller or other device.
misuse: Pair this icon with a visible label when identifying a connection.

16.reason: A stepped outline preserves the wide upper mouth and narrow lower walls. A short tongue stays separated from the frame.

24.reason: The upper mouth and inward shoulders retain the socket proportions while the central tongue keeps clear of the outline.
